title: The exact-pullback native derived exchange map
statement: Fix a prime $l$ and a commutative square $v:X'\to X$, $p':X'\to Y'$, $p:X\to Y$, $g:Y'\to Y$ of schemes. Use the native adic module categories and their ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework]. Write $P_f=D(f^*)$ for exact native pullback. Localize the actual native pullback-composition comparison to obtain $P_{p'}P_g\simeq P_vP_p$. Define the native exchange $P_gRp_*\to Rp'_*P_v$ as its unit-square-counit mate for the adjunctions $P_p\dashv Rp_*$ and $P_{p'}\dashv Rp'_*$ [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. This construction imposes no properness, constructibility, boundedness or Weil-structure hypothesis.
